results.name: register with several document rows (name + file) stores them as contracts
validation: missing name, missing file for a new row, malformed file → 400
edit: renaming a row keeps its file; omitting a row deletes it; new row is added
edit: replacing the file of an existing row; contract metadata (category/dates) is preserved
edit without a documents field leaves them untouched; empty list clears them
large payloads (3 × ~3 MB files) are accepted by the API body limit
